pages.title: What remains
pages.text: “Some things are too important to leave at the place of your death.”$(br2)Soul Shards let you preserve your items after dying. Purchase them in the progression menu. You start with no shards.$(br2)Each new slot costs experience equal to the number of shards you will own after buying it. The maximum is controlled by $(thing)soulShardMax$().

pages.title: A death cache
pages.text: To create a cache, you need:$(li)$(l:beginning/spirit_instinct)Ghost Instincts$(/l) enabled;$(li)at least one Soul Shard;$(li)a player death.$(br2)Black smoke appears at the place of death. Right-click it to recover your items. Only the owner can open the cache.$(br2)The number of simultaneous caches is limited by your Soul Shards. If you exceed the limit, the oldest cache disappears.

pages.title: If the Shard is gone
pages.text: The Soul Shard keeps your things in a backup. If it did not appear or has vanished, run $(bold)/spirit_shard$(): the shard returns beside you with all your things. If the old shard still exists, the command tells you where it is and creates nothing.
